findings: Raised geometry, mirrored direction and ink transfer are separate aspects of the described stamp process.

Unused cartridge, rotated, solvent, surface and upright were checked across all ten slots; rotated is specifically excluded as a substitute for mirror reversal.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/full-bank review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: stood above empty spaces定义raised凸起。inked为上墨非高低，rotated旋转、mirrored左右反转、upright竖直均不表示高于空白的部分；其他候选不合。
reversed left right明确mirrored镜像。rotated旋转不等于左右镜像，upright竖直、legible易读均不指反写；raised凸起是高度不是方向。
with small pad及printing face preparation表inked上墨。transferred为传递应说明对象去向不表用垫上墨，smudged弄糊不是准备动作；raised/mirrored不以墨垫完成。
a pushing force定义pressure压力。surface表面、cartridge墨盒、solvent溶剂是物件材料非施加的力，impressions是印迹，其他词不指该物理量。
from face to paper定义transferred转移。inked是给表面着墨不表示墨从一处到另一处，rotated旋转、smudged弄糊、raised升起均不指墨的转移。
printed marks same stamp直接定义impressions印迹。cartridge为墨盒、surface单数表面、pressure压力、solvent溶剂都非多次印得的标记名词。
edges blurred sideways movement定义smudged糊抹。mirrored只是方向反转非边缘糊，rotated转动不必糊、legible易读反而与糊不同，其他词不命名该印迹损坏。
paper took liquid in slowly对应less absorbent吸收性较弱。legible为字清晰、upright方向、raised凸面都不说明纸吸液速度；其他候选词性或含义不合。
similar thin coating across rather heavy patch定义evenly均匀地。其他候选没有修饰spread的均匀方式副词，pressure是力度名词，不能代替墨层分布。
clear enough read直接定义legible易辨读。upright只说明朝向可仍模糊，mirrored是反向、raised凸起、absorbent吸液均不保证文字能读；其他候选不表达该结果。

findings: Frequency, perceived pitch, loudness and duration are explicitly distinguished in a simplified steady-tone lesson.
The bridge transmits motion, cavity names the hollow space and body amplification is described without creating energy from nothing.
Plucking initiates motion; damping reduces it. The keys follow different stages rather than swapping generic sound verbs.
Unused friction, harmonics, louder, resonance and volume were checked in all slots; no audio asset is required because the relevant properties are described in words.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/full-bank review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: pulled aside released finger定义plucked拨弦。damped抑振为后来制止振动，transferred转移能量不指指拨动作；其他候选不作该弦受拨的过去分词。
backwards forwards repeatedly直接定义oscillates振荡。amplifies放大需合适声音对象，不能与in this way表来回运动相等，其他词非此单数主语动作。
number repeated movements period定义frequency频率。pitch是感知音高、volume声量、tension拉力、resonance共振，均非次数除时间的物理量名。
how high low sound seemed定义pitch音高。volume音量、frequency物理重复率都非此感知高低名称，harmonics泛音复数不接此单一感知属性；其他词不合。
force stretching string定义tension张力。friction摩擦不是拉紧力，volume音量、frequency频率、resonance共振不表示此力；其他词词性不合。
component at string end conveys movement body定义bridge琴桥。cavity是空腔非接弦组件，tension力、friction摩擦不是器件，其他项不命名所述传力结构。
from string into attached parts说明transferred传递。plucked为拨弦动作，damped减振不是指能量从一体到另一体；其他候选不作此被动迁移谓语。
hollow space enclosed body直接定义cavity空腔。bridge为琴桥实体，volume在此是量而非有界的空间结构名，harmonics声音成分不指空洞。
making radiated result stronger解释amplifies放大可听声辐射，不是创造能量。oscillates只振荡不以sound为及物宾语，louder形容副词不能作body后的谓语；其他项无该动词功能。
vibration reduced、sound died quicker定义damped阻尼抑制。transferred只说移动不直接命名振幅被减，plucked会激发而非结束振动；其他候选不作该抑振过去分词。

findings: Viability is capacity to live, longevity duration, germination the observed sprouting process and dormancy a possible reason a living seed does not sprout in one test.
Orthodox is explicitly defined for the exercise; no universal storage method is claimed for all species.
Accession identifies a collection, provenance its history, and regeneration creates a new generation that must be documented rather than relabelled as untouched originals.
Unused heterogeneous, initially, replicate, sterile and uniformly were checked against all slots; heterogeneous is not equivalent to representative of the prior range.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/full-bank review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: separately documented entry identifier history定义accession馆藏入藏批次。provenance为其来源信息非条目本身，regeneration更新过程、germination萌发都不指这个登记单元。
where seeds came from how reached bank定义provenance来源沿革。accession为集合条目、longevity寿命、viability活性均不是到馆流转历史；其他项词性或义不符。
capacity remain alive直接定义viability存活能力。longevity是这种能力维持多久，germination为开始萌发，dormancy暂停状态，不能代替存活性总概念。
process sprouting定义germination萌发。regeneration为更新整个种子供给，desiccation干燥、dormancy休眠与开始发芽不同；其他词不指该被观察过程。
growth suspended until conditions定义dormancy休眠。viability活性不必暂停，desiccation水移除、longevity寿命均不等于条件到来前暂停生长。
removal water drying定义desiccation脱水。germination萌发、regeneration繁殖更新、dormancy休眠不直接指水分移除；其他名词不合释义。
文中明确storage category for tolerating suitable drying cold称orthodox常规型。sterile不育或无菌与可存可长不同，representative代表性、heterogeneous异质性均非这里定义的储藏类别。
period seeds remain alive直接定义longevity寿命。viability只说存活能力而非期间长短，provenance来源、dormancy休眠状态都非存活年限；其他词不合。
growing plants produce renewed supply定义regeneration更新繁殖。germination只是种子起芽不包括后续产新种，replicate作动词或复制件也非这个明确繁殖周期名。
reflecting earlier range rather few thrive说明representative有代表性。heterogeneous仅多样不保证反映原批范围，sterile不育与产种矛盾，orthodox是储藏类别非代表关系；其他词不适合of结构。

findings: Attrition, observed data and later imputation are distinct stages; inserted values are not relabelled as directly reported answers.
The lottery is a hypothetical random mechanism. The actual commuting-related nonresponse example is explicitly a possibility, not asserted fact about a real survey.
Bias and uncertainty are different properties. Sensitivity checks vary assumptions and cannot eliminate every untested scenario.
Unused complete, covariance, simulate, weighted and withheld were checked against all slots; no missing answer is interpreted as a zero commute.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/full-bank review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: loss participants over time定义attrition流失。imputation为填补、bias偏差、covariance共变不指人员退出；其他项不合此现象名。
actually received rather supplied model定义observed已观测。complete只完整不保证直接取得，weighted为加权、withheld被隐匿均不表达实际收到，其他候选词性或义不符。
process explaining why absent直接定义mechanism机制。bias为结果偏差、uncertainty不确定性、sensitivity敏感性均不是缺失发生过程本身；其他名词不合。
genuine lottery determines chance rather commuter experience定义random随机。informative与经历相关的含信息缺失相反，complete完整、weighted加权、observed已观测都不说明抽签随机。
absence related relevant feature说明informative携带信息的。random表示不依经历抽签，weighted/complete/withheld不表示缺失与研究特征相关的性质，其他词不合。
replacing missing plausible values assumptions定义imputation插补。simulate是动词不能直接作considered后这一过程名，attrition为流失、covariance共变、bias偏差均非缺值替入。
pattern pushes estimate away target定义bias偏差。covariance共同变动不等于估计偏离，uncertainty不确定性不同于方向失真，mechanism机制不是误差性质；其他词不合。
instead known certainty定义uncertainty不确定性。sensitivity是受假设变化影响，covariance共变、bias系统偏离均不直接等于尚未知的程度；其他候选词性不合。
analysis varying reasonable assumptions看结论反应定义sensitivity敏感性分析。covariance分析两变量共变而非此假设变动，attrition流失、imputation插补本身不是本段核假设范围的分析名。
regular relevant pattern定义systematically系统性地。其余候选无此方式副词；random形容词不能直接修饰differed，且与regular相关模式不符。
